ingameEffects.label: Stampede Accident (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all squad members' ATK increases for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: All squad members' ATK is increased for 8s, stacking up to 4 times.
